response.original_title: Twin Peaks/Cop Rock: Behind the Scenes
response.overview: A promotional television special aired to prepare new viewers for the ABC series *Twin Peaks* (for its second season) and *Cop Rock* (for its first season). It includes clips from the first season of *Twin Peaks*, explanations of each of the main characters, and interviews with the actors and creators of the series. —Qylecoop
